_read_me: How this company's CRM exports become the data contract files (docs/DATA-CONTRACT.md). For each file: 'match' is the export's file name pattern, 'columns' maps contract column -> the export's own column name (only list the ones that differ; same names need no line), 'date_format' is how the export writes dates (Python strftime, for example %Y-%m-%d), and 'values' translates the CRM's words into the contract's (for example its sold stage into Approved). The rules session fills this in with the client; guides/any-crm-guide.md walks through it.

columns._example: Job Number <- the export's 'Job #' column would be written as  "Job Number": "Job #"
